analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI slightly down from 46.7 to 46.4, continuing neutral range consolidation. MACD histogram remains weak from -514.2672 to -541.5175. Volume ratio of 0.85 to 5-day average indicates lack of directional conviction. SMA5 ($82,006.93) and SMA20 ($83,560.01) are above current price ($81,473), acting as short-term resistance. SMA50 ($81,251.3) may act as support.
